exposure.method: Procedurally isolated reviewer on shared filesystem; no OS-enforced read barrier.
read: Mandatory orient/work output and work-command usage
notRead: additional source files beyond dossier excerpts
exposure.additionalContext: Mandatory repository AGENTS.md contains general project taxonomy/guarantee policy. orient/work exposed curation work status, counts and reference digest, but no reference judgments. exposure.sourceExecution: No lab source execution, imports, installs, edits or network. Only repository coordination commands and standalone artifact/data processing were executed.
exposure.independenceLimit: Same-model procedural independence; source-only evidence and shared filesystem, not statistical or model independence.

notes: Judgments concern source responsibility and expressibility, never implementation satisfaction or family admission.
Applicability uses broad responsibility; candidate restrictions that exclude real source duties are recorded as mismatches.
Parameters on mismatch/unknown rows are partial attempted instantiations, never complete valid contracts. Empty parameters/observations on non-applicable rows avoid inventing contracts.
Each row's taxonomy is assessed from its dossier before the frozen activation rule; role/facet facts are not derived from representation fit.
The aggregate case scope is retained. Where a dossier exposes a file-owned nested adaptation, scopeSignature names it explicitly; whole-function exceptional branches are not silently removed.
D2 expresses the observed dependency model; this review does not prove every delegated implementation lacks hidden state. Unknown effective dependencies are retained where material.
